info.name: GrubPac ERP API
info.description:
GrubPac ERP API — auth and administration (Phase 1 module RBAC).

Use Postman environment files under docs/api/postman/ for local, staging, pre-prod, and production baseUrl.

Keep in sync with docs/api/openapi.yaml when routes change.

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness and readiness probes for orchestration and local smoke checks.

request.description: GET /health — process liveness; no dependency checks.
GET /health/ready — PostgreSQL (pool + Drizzle) and Redis. Returns 503 with ApiError body if any check is down.

item.name: Realtime
item.description: Organization domain events (SSE). EventSource cannot send Authorization — use access_token query. Requires asset_register.view or fleet_leasing.view.

request.description: GET /events/stream — long-lived SSE; heartbeat every 30s. Prefer long-running API (ALB/ECS). Not suitable for API Gateway + Lambda.

item.name: Portal
item.description: Portal-wide utilities (header global search). Requires Bearer accessToken and organizationId.

request.description: GET /portal/search — RBAC-filtered global search; modules included match caller `{module}.view` keys.

item.name: Auth
item.description: JWT access + rotating refresh tokens. Run Login first; set collection variables accessToken, refreshToken, organizationId from responses.

request.description: POST /auth/login — returns accessToken, refreshToken, tokenType Bearer, expiresIn (seconds).
POST /auth/refresh — rotates refresh token; prior refresh is revoked.

GET /auth/me — user, memberships (permissionKeys, moduleAccess, permissionRevision per org), union permissionKeys/moduleAccess. Refetch after RBAC changes; revision bumps when roles/assignments change.
POST /auth/logout — revoke refresh session(s); Bearer access token required.
POST /auth/change-password — Bearer required; revokes all refresh tokens on success.
POST /auth/forgot-password — always generic message; stores hashed reset token; email via PASSWORD_RESET_EMAIL_MODE.
POST /auth/reset-password — single-use token from email or test hook.

item.name: Administration
item.description: RBAC admin APIs — Bearer accessToken; org context via organizationId query and/or X-Organization-Id header. Writes require administration.manage.

request.description: POST /users — administration.manage; creates user + active membership.
GET /roles — requires administration.view. List is filtered by role hierarchy unless actor has administration.manage (parent sees descendant roles).

POST /roles — create org role. Optional parentRoleId (UUID, same org); omit or null for hierarchy root (requires administration.manage). Without manage, set parentRoleId to a role you manage. 400: ROLE_PARENT_REQUIRED, ROLE_PARENT_NOT_FOUND; 404 ROLE_NOT_FOUND if parent not visible. moduleAccess expands to permission keys.
POST /roles — child role with parentRoleId set (use {{parentRoleId}} or {{roleId}} from a parent create/list). Parent must exist in org and be visible to actor.
GET /roles/:id — administration.view; org-scoped. Returns 404 ROLE_NOT_FOUND when id is missing or role is outside actor hierarchy visibility (IDOR-safe).

PATCH /roles/:id — administration.manage. Optional parentRoleId to reparent; null clears parent (administration.manage only). 400: ROLE_PARENT_MANAGE_REQUIRED, ROLE_HIERARCHY_CYCLE, ROLE_PARENT_NOT_FOUND; 404 ROLE_NOT_FOUND when role/parent not visible.
DELETE /roles/:id — administration.delete or administration.manage. 409 ROLE_IS_SYSTEM (system roles); 409 ROLE_HAS_CHILDREN when child roles exist in hierarchy.
GET /roles/editor-matrix — NONE/VIEW/MANAGE/FULL rows per sidebar module.
GET /modules — sidebar module registry for role editor.

item.name: Asset Register
item.description: Asset classes (2026-10-12 meeting spec). Masters retired in UI; class-only fleet register. Set assetClassId from Create asset class.

request.description: GET /asset-register/catalog/intake-checklist-items — seed labels for asset class create form.

GET /asset-register/asset-classes — paginated list; each item includes id (UUID, stable assetClassId), name, specLabel, vehicleType, fuelType, inFleetCount, availableCount, status. Optional search, status.
POST /asset-register/asset-classes — required: vehicleType, fuelType, mileage, fuelTankCapacity, ratedLoadFrom/To, intakeChecklistItems (min 1). Spec fields optional; name/code generated server-side.

GET /asset-register/vehicles — filter assetClassId, operationalStatus, lifecycle status, search, demandFilter. List items include openDemandUnitsToAssign and openDemandContractCount per asset class; includeAssignmentSummary=true adds org-wide assignmentSummary.

POST /asset-register/vehicles — fleetCode VH-1001+ per org; registrationNumber unique per org (trim + case-insensitive). 409 when duplicate. Active asset class only (class-only register; asset master layer retired).
GET /asset-register/vehicles/{id} — class and master names joined.
PATCH /asset-register/vehicles/{id} — blocked when inactive; operationalStatus not client-writable in v1.

item.name: List assignable lease contracts for vehicle

request.description: GET assignable lease contracts for a fleet register vehicle (matching asset class line; assignable false when fully allocated).
POST bulk-assign/validate — per-vehicle availability before Review submit; replacementAvailableCount for auto-replace UX.

POST bulk-assign — active lease only; 409 BULK_ASSIGN_VEHICLE_CONFLICT when selection stale (no partial assign); success includes lineCommitted, lineAllocatedAfter, remainingInPoolForClass, fullyAssignedLine.
GET /asset-register/compliance — expired | expiring_soon | valid from vehicle date fields.

item.name: Fleet & Leasing
item.description: Lease contract wizard and lifecycle. Set leaseContractId from Create draft response.

body.raw:
{
  "organizationId": "{{organizationId}}",
  "companyName": "Meridian Fleet Client",
  "taxId": "29ABCDE1234F1Z5",
  "addressLine1": "12 Industrial Estate",
  "addressCountry": "IN",
  "addressState": "Maharashtra",
  "addressDistrict": "Mumbai",
  "addressPincode": "400001",
  "pointsOfContact": [
    {
      "name": "Aditi Rao",
      "contactNumber": "+919876543201",
      "email": "aditi@meridian.example",
      "isPrimary": true
    }
  ]
}

request.description: POST /fleet-leasing/clients — structured address required; optional GSTIN taxId; POC phone validated E.164.
GET /fleet-leasing/asset-classes — distinct asset classes from fleet vehicle master (wizard dropdown).

POST /fleet-leasing/asset-classes/availability/preview — pool available per class (register units minus other contracts' unallocated commitments). Optional excludeContractId when editing an existing draft so its own lines are not double-reserved. LEASE-03 MVP gate (mvpAllLinesCovered).
POST /fleet-leasing/lease-contracts — explicit Save draft / batch create. Optional clientId, terms, assetLines, confirmShortfall. 400 INVALID_CLIENT; 409 ASSET_SHORTFALL without confirmShortfall.
GET .../review — client, lines, terms, pricingEvaluation, reviewAction, messages, canSubmit.
PUT .../terms — saves step 3; returns contract + pricingEvaluation.
POST .../submit — legacy pending-approval path; MVP wizard uses POST .../confirm (Submit contract) instead.
POST .../confirm — Submit contract (MVP); activates or awaiting_assets without pending approval. Response includes confirmation summary.
GET .../change-history — field-level FROM/TO rows from lease_contract_edit_logs.
GET .../confirmation — allocationByLine, infoMessages; active, awaiting_assets, or approved.
GET .../{id} — subtitle, statusTags, statusBanner, lifecycleLogs, availableActions, returnProgress, terminatedAt.
PATCH .../{id} — edit client, terms, asset lines, optional vehicleIds. Blocked on closed/concluded/pending_termination. Returns detail + pricingEvaluation when terms/lines change.
POST .../approve — pending approval → active or awaiting_assets; requires fleet leasing approve permission.
POST .../activate — direct activation path for eligible contract states.
POST .../deactivate — active only; reason required; onHold true, billing continues.
POST .../reactivate — direct to active/awaiting_assets; no approval.
GET /fleet-leasing/support/on-lease-vehicle-lookup — fleet register registration, VIN/chassis, or fleet code on an eligible active lease.
GET /fleet-leasing/support/replacement-candidates — available compliant vehicles (optional vehicleType, brand, modelName, assetClass, excludeVehicleIds).
GET /fleet-leasing/support/available-replacement-lookup — registration, VIN/chassis, or fleet code for an available replacement (not on another active contract).
GET /fleet-leasing/support/replacement-filter-options — distinct brands for vehicleType, or models when brand is also set.
POST .../renew — active only; updates term/dates on same contract; 12+ months = renewal, under 12 = extension; deposit unchanged.
POST .../terminate — from deactivated, billing_paused, or legacy pending_termination; closes contract in one step.

item.name: Organisation
item.description: Organisation module — location types, locations, suppliers, clients, drivers (assign/unassign), and employees. Send Bearer token plus x-organization-id and/or organizationId query on org-scoped calls.

request.description: GET /organisation/location-types — seeds system presets per org on first call.
DELETE /organisation/location-types/{id} — custom types only; returns 409 when type is in use.
GET /organisation/locations — paginated list with optional search, locationTypeId, status. Default sort: createdAt desc (newest first), then id desc.

GET /organisation/suppliers/{id} — detail with linkedSections. Driver-type suppliers return linked drivers (page 1, max 50). Other linked rows empty until inventory/asset/compliance modules ship.

GET /organisation/drivers — paginated list with optional search and status (active, inactive, license-expired).
POST /organisation/drivers/{id}/unassign — clears assignment; inactive when tied to contract.
GET /organisation/drivers/assignable-vehicles — active lease contract vehicles without a linked driver.
GET /organisation/employees — paginated list for employee register and location assignment dropdowns. Default sort: createdAt desc (newest first), then id desc.

item.name: Finance
item.description: Finance invoices, vendor payments, client statements, and interim inventory parts catalog.

request.description: GET /finance/invoices — paginated list with optional search, status, invoiceType.
GET /finance/invoices/asset-classes/catalog — vehicle purchase invoice asset class picker (finance.view).
POST /finance/invoices/sale — SINV-{year}-{seq}; vehicle must be available in fleet register.
POST /finance/invoices/billing/lease — BINV-{year}-{seq}; client must link to fleet client; contract billable.
PATCH /finance/invoices/{id} — unpaid sale/billing only; purchase uses remove.
DELETE /finance/invoices/{id} — hard delete unpaid purchase invoice only.
GET /finance/inventory-parts — interim catalog for spare-parts purchase invoices.
POST /finance/inventory-parts — inline catalog create for purchase spare-parts lines.
GET /finance/vendor-payments/purchase-invoices/catalog — unpaid/partial purchase invoices with balance.
POST /finance/vendor-payments — canonical path for purchase invoice payments.
DELETE /finance/vendor-payments/{id} — latest payment on invoice only (LIFO).
GET /finance/client-statements — billing-only aggregates per org client for a period.
POST /finance/client-statements/{clientId}/send — audit log only; email deferred.

item.name: Inventory
item.description: Stock register, receipts, balance, and read-only parts requests.

item.name: Workshop
item.description: Labor job card templates and work orders (AMC phased).

asc or desc when sortBy is set
